items.overview:
Several physiotherapy clinics in Vancouver offer WorkSafeBC (WCB) approved injury rehabilitation and direct billing:

Top Vancouver WCB / WorkSafeBC Physiotherapy Clinics

	* West 4th Physiotherapy Clinic _(Kitsilano - 2211 W 4th Ave)_ – Handles WorkSafeBC claims and direct billing in-house.

	* The Physio Shop _(Commercial Dr - 2260 Commercial Dr)_ – Offers dedicated WorkSafeBC physiotherapy services.

	* Base Physio + Wellness _(Fraser St - 3865 Fraser St)_ – Frequently treats approved WCB/WorkSafeBC workplace injury claims with direct billing.

	* Vancouver Physiotherapy Hub _(Downtown - 970 Burrard St)_ – Multidisciplinary clinic experienced in injury recovery and workplace rehabilitation.

	* West End Physiotherapy Clinic _(West End - 1166 Alberni St)_ – Provides targeted recovery care for sprains, post-op, and physical strains.

-------------------------

What You Need to Know Before You Go

	* Report the Injury: Make sure you have reported your workplace injury to your employer and filed a claim with WorkSafeBC to get an active claim number.

	* Direct Billing: Most authorized WCB/WorkSafeBC clinics will direct-bill the board once you provide your approved or pending claim number.

	* Bring Details: Call ahead with your WorkSafeBC claim number, date of injury, and employer contact info so the clinic can confirm coverage before your first assessment.

If you let me know your neighborhood in Vancouver or preferred time of day, I can recommend the closest clinic or check availability for you.
